title: First-passage horizons in HVG: rank-invariant path-roughness estimator verified from first-passage persistence and HVG; rough Bergomi H=0.1, verification via fBm/RB numeric experiments; deployment on 20plus years VIX rolling W1024 step126 with overlapping-window iid Monte Carlo nulls (single-window 95% envelope and rolling-mean/count Monte Carlo p) and block bootstrap CIs; sensitivity for ties/censoring/additive noise/thinning; control processes i.i.d./BM/GBM/OU and benchmark vol models Heston/GARCH/FIGARCH.
hypothesis: Uncensored forward visibility horizon Lp = first-passage time Tp, iid null Pr[Lp>=k]=1/k theta_iid=1 infinite mean/variance diverges via harmonic series and sum (2k-1)Pr>=k, discrete-grid persistence theory gives theta(H)=1-H for fBm and conditional theta(H)=1-H for rBergomi-type vol under persistence hypothesis Eq hyp-rl that RL-fBm increments below 0 scales like fBm etc. All fBm validations done using Davies-Harte exact sampling where Lp=Tp holds by definition of uncensored horizons. Method inputs: window W, T, N draws/paths/replicates/permutations, lags, thresholds ell0, caps, weights, null values, benchmarks 1/k, 1-H.
data_sources: Federal Reserve Economic Data (FRED) series VIXCLS daily CBOE VIX level, publicly available without licence, used as implied volatility proxy not realized variance
sample: Multiple Monte Carlo and empirical samples reported separately: 1) fBm Davies-Harte ensemble Sec4.2 N=10,000 paths per H in {0.1,...,0.9} length T=2^{16}, N=50 for control Table1 and N=30 for T-bias FigA; 2) Rough Bergomi heatmap Sec5.2 grid H x eta H in {0.05,0.10,0.15,0.20,0.30} eta in {0.2,0.4} xi0=0.04 hybrid scheme kappa=1 T=2^{16} N=10,000 per cell, N=500 for heatmap caption correction cells mean of 10000; 3) Model comparison Sec5.3 four volatility models T=2^{16} N=10,000 rough Bergomi H=0.1 eta=0.3, Heston kappa=2 theta_var=0.04 sigma=0.5 rho=-0.7 V0=0.04, GARCH omega1e-6 alpha0.05 beta0.94 persistence0.99, FIGARCH d0.4 phi0.10 beta0.60 truncation250 warmup250; 4) VIX empirical Sec6 FRED VIXCLS daily level 2000-01-03 to 2026-04-30 n=6651 trading days rolling W=1024 step126 four-year windows N_windows=45; 5) iid null Sec6-AppB single-window W=2^9 to 2^16 N=1000/500 uniform replicates and overlapping-window null 1000 paths length6651 rolling W=1024 step126; 6) iid uniform decay Sec4.2 N=50 each T=2^14/2^16/2^18/2^20. Filters: paths with no ties, time-order tie breaking if xt+k==xt later is crossing, finite-sample terminal non-crossings right-censored complete-case Hill main with censored-Pareto and lower-bound sensitivity checks, rank-invariant monotone stack O(T) next-greater-or-equal. Censoring: average 24.4 censored per 1024-day VIX window 21.8 above threshold.
method: 1. Compute forward visibility horizon Lp(t)=sup{k>=1:(t,t+k) in E[HVG(x)], x_{t+k}>=x_t, t+k<=T}; Lemma1 uncensored Lp=Tp=inf{k>=1:x_{t+k}>=x_t} HVG condition x_{t+m}<min(x_t,x_{t+k}); if empty right-censored infinite-path prob0; O(T) monotone stack next-greater-or-equal; ties deterministic time-order later counts as crossing, stricter equal-not-cross shift 0.003 on VIX.

2. Sample L=(Lp(t_i))_{i=1}^n with n<=T-1 uncensored only; main Hill complete-case; tail exponent via Hill-MLE theta(ell0)= n_{ell0} / sum_{L_i>=ell0} log(L_i/ell0) n_{ell0}=#{L_i>=ell0}; asymptotic SE theta/sqrt(n_{ell0}) replaced by stationary block bootstrap Politis-Romano mean block b=ceil(T^{1/3}) B=200 resamples for dependence-aware CIs.

3. Threshold ell0 selected by Clauset-Shalizi-Newman: candidate set all integer thresholds 1 to min(19, floor(q0.9)) plus 30 logarithmically spaced integer thresholds between 20 and empirical 90% quantile q0.9 duplicates removed; for each compute theta(ell0) and KS distance between empirical tail above ell0 and continuous-Pareto reference with exponent theta(ell0); minimizer reported ell0star; FigA Hill plot flat [10,60] move <0.02; practitioner report theta with ell0star and tail size n_{ell0star}.

4. Right-censoring sensitivity at ell0star: censored Pareto likelihood theta_cens = n_u / ( sum_{i in u} log(L_i/ell0star) + sum_{j in c} log(C_j/ell0star)) u uncensored c censored lower bounds C_j; conservative lower-bound fit treats each C_j as exact horizon; per VIX window mean 24.4 censored 21.8 above threshold; including censored lowers theta so complete-case conservative for heavy-tail.

5. i.i.d. null Prop1: X_i i.i.d. continuous Lp>=k iff X_t max of block size k Prob=1/k =Renyi record; series sum1/k diverges E=inf Var=inf via sum(2k-1)Pr>=k; power-law survival exponent theta_iid=1 closed-form null.

6. fBm prediction Cor1: fb m H sampled on integer grid persistence p_k(H)=Prob[fbm_1<0...fbm_k<0]=k^{-(1-H)+o(1)} Molchan1999 discrete counterpart sup<=1 barrier; stationarity increments event {Tp>k}={fbm_{t+j}-fbm_t<0 j=1..k} Prob =p_k => theta(H)=1-H; intuition small H thin tail large theta large H smooth heavy tail.

7. Rough Bergomi Eq rb v_t=xi0 exp(eta Z^H_t -0.5 eta^2 t^{2H}) Z^H_t= sqrt(2H)int_0^t (t-s)^{H-1/2} dW_s hybrid scheme BennedsenLundePakkanen kappa=1; rank-invariance Lp(v)=Lp(log v) since log uniform but Lp(log v)!=Lp(Z^H) due to t-dependent drift -0.5 eta^2 t^{2H}; first-passage event {Tp>k}={Z^H_{t+j}-Z^H_t < eta/2[(t+j)^{2H}-t^{2H}] } persistence RL-fBm increment below g_t(s)=eta/2[(t+s)^{2H}-t^{2H}]. Prop3 conditional result fix H in (0,0.5] eta>0 xi0>0 window [t0,t1] subset(0,1) sstar(t)=(c_H/(eta H) t^{1-2H})^{1/(1-H)} c_H coeff sqrtVar=c_H s^H+o(s^H) hypothesis persistence of RL-fBm increment below zero scales k^{-(1-H)+o(1)} Eq hyp-rl then for 1<<k<<T sstar Prob[Tp>=k]=k^{-(1-H)+o(1)} theta=1-H; Step1 drift g_t(s)=eta H t^{2H-1} s+O(s^2) ratio r(s,t)=eta H t^{2H-1}/c_H s^{1-H}+o(s^{1-H}) vanishing s->0 set r=1 => sstar rigorous Volterra; Step2 transfer hypothesis only non-rigorous input discussed Remark1 locally self-similar index H covariance asymptotes stationary fBm; Step3 drift positive deterministic sub-leading asymptotically indistinguishable from zero by AurzadaDereichLifshits Thm1.3 exponent unchanged only prefactor; Caveat H>1/2 not pursued; Remark2 numeric check eta0.3 T2^16 H[0.05,0.30] sstar>1 for t[0.1,0.9] r<=0.28 uniformly max(1,0.1) r<=1e-3 at s~3e-4 ell0~20 operative.

8. Validation fBm Davies-Harte exact circulant embedding fractional Gaussian noise spectral sampling real/imag Gaussians; N10000 T2^16 per H Fig2 bars Monte-Carlo 95% envelopes; Table1 reports cross-replicate mean hat sigma bias ellbar; recovers within 1 sigma for H<=0.2 bias positive from H0.3 upward heavy tails rare events scarce at available T; App FigA bias decay monotonic H0.1 +0.078 at 2^12 to -0.010 at 2^18 H0.5 +0.200 at 2^12 to +0.046 at 2^18 N30 each; no length <2^18 bias <0.1 for H>=0.7.

9. Controls T2^16 N50 SE=sigma/sqrt(N): iid uniform 1.021±0.002 sigma0.012 predicted1.00 Prop finite-sample discrete tail bias ~0.02 decays log W 1.041,1.024,1.016,1.014 at 2^14,2^16,2^18,2^20 N50 each; iid Gaussian 1.024; BM 0.569 fBm H0.5 0.50; OU dense dt0.01 0.653 locally BM vs sparse dt1.0 1.052 near independent; GBM sigma0.2 mu0.05 0.570 same as BM rank-invariance strictly increasing transformation uniform across t; add noise moderate sigma<=0.3std bias<0.02 sigma1.0 0.984 to iid null; thinning to 50% unchanged.

10. Rough Bergomi heatmap Sec5.2 H in {0.05,0.10,0.15,0.20,0.30} eta0.2,0.4 xi00.04 T2^16 N10000 per cell: max eta diff 4.8e-4 negligible, H dependence matches 1-H within 0.003 for H<=0.15 within 0.01 for H0.2 bias for H0.3 consistent Table1.

11. Model comparison Sec5.3 SPX-like calibrated four models T2^16 N10000 roughness diagnostic on variance trajectory v_t: rB H0.1 eta0.3, Heston kappa2 thetavar0.04 sigma0.5 rho-0.7 V00.04 full-truncation Euler reflection, GARCH omega1e-6 alpha0.05 beta0.94 persistence0.99 standard recursion, FIGARCH d0.4 phi0.10 beta0.60 truncated ARCH250 weights pi_j=pi_{j-1}(j-1-d)/j lambda(L)=1-(1-betaL)^{-1}(1-phiL)(1-L)^d warmup250; Table3 hat SE 95% MC envelope; contrasts hat_rB-hat_Heston 0.3355 combined SE0.00024, GARCH between, FIGARCH 0.840 delicate closer to rB than GARCH long memory mimics roughness, separation rB-FIGARCH 0.0580 combined SE0.00020 small caveat insufficient to falsify long-memory on <10y daily; reference lines BM iid from Table2.

12. VIX empirical Sec6 FRED VIXCLS level daily n6651 2000-01-03 to2026-04-30 rank-invariant directly on level; stress test of implied proxy not latent instantaneous variance; rolling W1024 step126 45 windows Fig5; stats mean0.91 SD0.19 range [0.72,1.51] Table4 [0.723,1.506] 43/45 above0.7 consistent Hvol(0,0.3) horizontal lines theta0.9 rough and 0.5 BM grey band single-window 95% iid envelope W1024; censor sensitivity Table4 complete-case 0.910±0.190, censored Pareto 0.674±0.102, lower-bound 0.757±0.099 including censored lowers exponent conservative; single-window null N1000 uniform W1024 mean1.166 SD0.091 95%[1.017,1.376] Table null; overlapping-window null 1000 iid paths length6651 rolling same scheme count below 1.017: VIX 35/45 vs null mean1.35 99%7 max10 p~=0.001 add-one smoothing, rolling mean VIX0.910 vs null1.160±0.026 p~=0.001; deployment ordinal deviation from locally i.i.d. not proof of rough instantaneous variance; discussion bias grows with H, asymptotic distribution under dependence unknown block bootstrap surrogate, terminal censoring matters short windows, separability rB-FIGARCH ~0.06.
